maria_infra: Heads-up: seeing ~30% throughput drop across west-2 inference pool, started ~16:13 UTC. Several workers restarted. Dashboard: https://redwood/dash/cluster/west-2 (incident id 1840017850)
ben_runtime: Looking. Worker logs show repeated cudaMalloc failures then restart. Not full node OOM, many per-process small alloc failures.
travis_ml: Any recent model deploys or quant changes?
maria_infra: No canary deploys. Autoscaler did some rebalancing at 16:12.
ben_runtime: Profiler snapshot looks bad — kernel selection fell back from fused-attn to fallback kernel for longer seqs, and allocator logs show slab fragmentation (lots of freed small slabs not coalescing).
ben_runtime: ```
allocator: slab_free_list: [64KB: 1024, 128KB: 512, 1MB: 8]
alloc_fail: size=96KB ctx=kv_cache_put
worker: pid=4219 msg="cudaMalloc failed"
```
sophie_sre: Is this noisy-tenant? any single job spiking allocs?
ben_runtime: Yes — tenant svc-847 had a sharp increase in small KV writes. KV cache evictions oscillating. Their effective batch size bounced between 1 and 8 every ~30s.
travis_ml: That smells like a feedback loop: latency spike -> heuristic shrinks batch -> more tiny allocations -> fragmentation -> more OOMs.
ben_runtime: Also seeing kernel mismatch: runtime picked `attn_basic` for these non-contiguous KV layouts after repeated evictions instead of `attn_fused` — much slower and higher alloc churn.
maria_infra: Proposed mitigations: 1) throttle svc-847 quota, 2) pin kernel to attn_fused for model-x on west-2 for 2h, 3) trigger node memory compaction and graceful worker restarts.
sophie_sre: I'll throttle svc-847 now. @deploy-bot can you pin kernel? :white_check_mark: 
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: pin request received for model-x on west-2 (pin id pending)
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: pinned kernel attn_fused for model-x on pool west-2 (id: pin-1840017850)
ben_runtime: Running compaction on affected nodes. Command run on gpu-17: `sudo /usr/bin/gpu-mem-compact --force` — compaction finished, restarted worker gracefully. Post-restart allocations look stable.
travis_ml: I'm preparing a change to the batching heuristic: add hysteresis on shrink (don't reduce batch size until 60s of sustained latency increase) to avoid oscillation.
maria_infra: Throughput recovering to baseline over last 12m. Keeping throttle for 30m and opening postmortem.
sophie_sre: Creating incident P0 postmortem: https://redwood/incidents/1840017850 — assigning to ben_runtime and travis_ml.
ben_runtime: Follow-ups: allocator reclamation patch (coalesce small free slabs), add KV cache eviction backpressure, and emit kernel-selection telemetry + alert when fallback rate >5%.
travis_ml: I'll open PR for hysteresis + tests and link to the incident.
maria_infra: Thanks team. Marking as monitoring — will resolve after 30m stable. :thumbsup:
